ADMIN_TAB_SETTINGS_DESC: How fast characters get hungry, thirsty and calm down, and what the HUD shows.
ADMIN_C_NEEDS_DESC: Hunger and thirst drop over time; food and drink items fill them up.
ADMIN_C_SHOW_DESC: Parts of the HUD players see while playing.
ADMIN_H_RATE: Points lost every minute from 100. 0.25 empties in about 6.5 hours of play.
ADMIN_H_STRESS_RELIEF: Stress points that fade every minute. Shooting and fast driving add stress.
ADMIN_H_EMPTY_DAMAGE: Health lost every 10 seconds while food or water is at 0. 0 turns it off.
